dimensions.assessment: Affects federal tourism officials, music-related attractions, venues, and travelers interested in music and sports tourism.
dimensions.evidence: identify locations and events in the United States that are important to music tourism and facilitate and promote domestic travel and tourism to those locations and events

dimensions.assessment: Involves promotional and reporting responsibilities rather than broad regulatory mandates or direct financial benefits.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee... a report of activities, findings, achievements, and vulnerabilities relating to the goals

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or federal spending increases are stated in the source text.
Amends the Visit America Act to add music tourism definitions, promotional duties, and periodic reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Visit America Act to promote music tourism, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent duties for the agency alongside ongoing reporting requirements every two years.
dimensions.evidence: not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of the American Music Tourism Act of 2025, and every 2 years thereafter

missing_information: Any details regarding funding or budget allocations for the promotional activities.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill expands the mandate of the National Travel and Tourism Office to include the promotion of music tourism and sports travel.
